title: Quantity
description: Canonical scalar quantity with unit, scale, and decimal value. Owner: platform/contracts. Consumers must not alter unit interpretation semantics.

value.description: Decimal quantity as a string to preserve precision.

unit.description: Unit of measure. Must be from a controlled vocabulary when the domain requires it.

scale.description: Number of decimal places used for the value. Semantic meaning of the value depends on scale and unit together.
